---
title: "AutoSite"
---

AutoSite identifies potential ligand-binding pockets by clustering high-affinity points of AutoDock affinity maps.

::: {.callout-note}
This page is being moved from the CCSB website. Until then, overview, downloads, documentation
and tutorials are at **[ccsb.scripps.edu/autosite](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/autosite/)**.
:::
